purpose: Test immediate symmetric neighbors of a fixed verified window incumbent after the v006-v008 performance stall.

fixed_anchor.scope: Verified v001-v008 window best; anchor stays fixed even if later observations improve.

selection.within_stratum_order: sha256(r80-shell-pilot-v1 + NUL + anchor_pattern_sha256 + NUL + row_2digits,col_2digits + NUL + candidate_pattern_sha256)
selection.shell_rule: First valid unreserved candidate per stratum after exact symmetry/feed/profile checks.
selection.control_rule: First eligible row in the immutable existing blind-pool manifest, excluding all reserved and selected shell hashes.
selection.annotation_fields: Original model/member hashes, generation/fit/protocol/manifest identity, response/radiation curves and derived predictor scalars.

dispatch.permanent_unavailability: Freeze the unavailable reason and resume ordinary collection; never fill another stratum, switch anchor/control/radius, or starve final target completion.

pre_pilot_baseline.reference_time: Preparation-time frozen reference; not refreshed by later successes before dispatch or readout.
pre_pilot_baseline.scope: All unique successful R80 patterns in the stable preparation snapshot, with raw sample/radiation and observation-entry bindings.
pre_pilot_baseline.duplicate_representative: Prefer a normal observation to repeat/notarize; otherwise deterministic queue and manifest order.
pre_pilot_baseline.scalar_schema: schema_version, created_utc, request/pilot/profile identity, representative_order, finite S11/gain/factory/radiation/clipped-radiation margins, B, prior_nonnegative, exact 2D/3D frontier hashes, pair metadata hashes, chosen full observation entries and sample/radiation SHA256 bindings.
pre_pilot_baseline.construction_race: Require pair/results metadata and chosen raw hashes unchanged before/after construction; otherwise LiveSnapshotChanged before immutable publication.
pre_pilot_baseline.commit_recheck: Chosen raw hashes and full observation entries must remain identical; added results may coexist without replacing the frozen reference.
pre_pilot_baseline.B: Maximum measured min(s11_margin,gain_margin) in the frozen pre-pilot baseline.
pre_pilot_baseline.relevance: Both measured response margins >= B-3.0 dB.
pre_pilot_baseline.material_rule: Factory improves frozen B by >=0.30 dB, or relevant uncovered response/radiation frontier, or first factory>=0 dB relative to this frozen reference.

readout.requires: 16/16 valid unique physical observations with zero result/marker errors; missing/error rows are incomplete.
readout.shell_positive: At least one of the 15 targeted rows is material against the frozen pre-pilot baseline.
readout.shell_red: All 16 observations valid and no targeted material point; zero relevant targeted points is explicitly red.

limits: No patterns, prospective model calls, dispatch or HFSS results exist at this protocol milestone.
The 16 hashes, current-model binding and complete pre-pilot frontier are frozen by future preparation, before dispatch.
A tiny local pilot does not establish symmetry causation, radiation-field mirroring, global exhaustion or future-SM performance.
Model generation labels denote annotation provenance; this cohort is not an ordinary 40/30/30 SM selection generation.
Intervening ordinary successes remain in the campaign and later training; pilot progress is relative to its preparation-time frozen reference, not a current global-best or campaign-first assertion.
Existing user authorization covers bounded symmetric optimization; healthy workers and normal collection continue.
